gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY WHERE SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.stddev_total_units, AVG(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE ss.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.stddev_total_units

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Mathematics%' ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, SUM(num_courses) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_courses) > 0 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, num_courses FROM inner_cte WHERE num_courses = ( SELECT MAX(num_courses) FROM inner_cte );

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) / NULLIF(AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) AS avg_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_area > (SELECT AVG(AREA) FROM FCLT_ROOMS) ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MAJOR_USE_DESC, SUM(AREA) AS total_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS GROUP BY MAJOR_USE_DESC ) SELECT MAJOR_USE_DESC, total_area FROM inner_cte WHERE total_area > ( SELECT AVG(AREA) FROM FCLT_ROOMS );

SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, VARIANCE(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS dept_budget_code_variance, STDDEV(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS dept_budget_code_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME

SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS dept_budget_code_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_full_name FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ) GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) > 0 ;

SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY num_courses DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME;

SELECT fo.MAJOR_ORG AS major_organization_name, VARIANCE(fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS hr_department_code_old_variance FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo WHERE fo.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') GROUP BY fo.MAJOR_ORG ;

SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY WHERE SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ;

SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE;

SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code, MAX(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) - MIN(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS range_dept_budget_code, VARIANCE(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS var_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME

SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR

SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(year_construct_began) OVER (ORDER BY year_construct_began, building_sort, BUILDING_NUMBER) = year_construct_began THEN NULL WHEN BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE year_construct_began END AS `YEAR CONSTRUCT BEGAN`, BUILDING_NUMBER AS BUILDING, year_occupied AS `YEAR INITIALLY OCCUPIED` FROM (SELECT year_construct_began, temp2.BUILDING_NUMBER, CASE WHEN FAC_BUILDING.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL THEN IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(FAC_BUILDING.DATE_OCCUPIED, '%m/%d/%Y'), '%Y'), 'UNKNOWN') ELSE NULL END AS year_occupied, CASE WHEN FAC_BUILDING.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL THEN building_sort ELSE NULL END AS building_sort FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL THEN year_construct_began ELSE CONCAT(year_construct_began, '*') END AS year_construct_began, BUILDING_NUMBER FROM (SELECT IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(DATE_BUILT, '%m/%d/%Y'), '%Y'), 'UNKNOWN') AS year_construct_began, BUILDING_NUMBER FROM FAC_BUILDING WHERE ownership_type = 'OWNED' AND PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL) temp1 GROUP BY year_construct_began, BUILDING_NUMBER HAVING year_construct_began IS NOT NULL) temp2 LEFT JOIN FAC_BUILDING ON FAC_BUILDING.BUILDING_NUMBER = temp2.BUILDING_NUMBER) temp3 UNION ALL SELECT NULL, CONCAT(COUNT(FAC_BUILDING.BUILDING_NUMBER), ' Buildings'), NULL FROM FAC_BUILDING WHERE ownership_type = 'OWNED' AND PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL;
